notes.title: Sophie's Curse on mobile devices?
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i356.photobucket.com/albums/oo10/getout9/MOBILEPROMO_zpsdehur5z2.png[/IMG]

It's no secret that I have been working on a mobile version of Sophie's Curse for the last few months and I was hoping to release it next week or so, but I just accidentally released on android right now while doing some tests.

Luckily the game is stable enough and I haven't encountered any bugs yet but this is my first mobile game ever so there might be a few hiding in there.

This mobile version is not exactly the same as the PC version but they are pretty much alike, it's what I originally envision for the game when I started the development, but then I started adding stuff and very quickly the game started using too much RAM to be able to run on mobile, but after a lot of optimization and going back to the initial idea I was able to finally port it, feel free to try it for FREE at Google Play:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trerplay.sophiescurse

The IOS version is now available guys: 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sophies-curse-scary-game/id1161176392?ls=1&mt=8

If you were planning on buying Sophie's Curse for PC please wait, as I just requested Valve a price change to $1.99! now that there is a FREE mobile version I think that $1.99 is a good price for the PC version (which is more complete), and hopefully that would help me a little bit to fight piracy... because even though Sophie’s Curse was extremely popular on Youtube with thousands of videos and millions of views, the sales weren’t that great  unfortunately there is huge amount of people pirating SC, and I hope that with the new price change they finally turn into buying customers.

notes.title: Update 3.0 - Steam Achievements + More!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17405515/5caa31caee6bd309f7815aaff8a7eb06750ba429.gif[/img]

Before fully committing to another project, I wanted to improve Sophie's Curse as much as possible, so today I released update 3.0.

This update includes:

-Steam achievements
-Improved frame rate to 60 FPS(before it was locked to 30)
-Improved graphics a bit (It looks better now)
-Smoother animations
-Optimized the code to run better on most computers
-The player now moves/runs a little bit faster
-And I also fixed the Steam overlay

Steam achievements were one of the most requested feature since SC was released, but to be completely honest with you guys... I had no clue on how to implement them into the game, but after many many tries and many headaches I was finally able to implement them... it was pretty easy actually I wish I figured out sooner xD

Better late than never right? Anyways I hope you guys enjoy this update :)
I did huge changes to my code, and I haven't found any bugs yet but please if you find one, let me know so I can fix it right away. (There might be a few bugs hiding in there)

Note* Since the game is now running at 60 FPS, it might run a little slower on low end PCs... If you encounter any issues like this let me know, perhaps I can add the OPTION to limit the frame rate to 30 FPS again.

Update#3.01
I just fixed a couple things.

notes.title: Update#275 – Re-cap.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17405515/84bf06aec7749f5ba05a0be5f2d07930156c63de.jpg[/img]

•In update#275 many small bugs were fixed, mostly related with audio.
•If you beat the game now in curse mode you get a bronze lighting device and if you beat it in nightmare mode you get a gold lighting device.
•Some of Sophie’s animations were also improved.
•Difficulty was balanced a bit more, I think its perfect now.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It's been 1 month since update#275 was released and I’m proud to announce that not a single bug has been found.

I’m really happy with the positive reviews Sophie’s Curse has received, and it has been an amazing journey, thousands of players are enjoying and getting jumpscared by Sophie worldwide… and its very fun watching your gameplay videos! I want to thank you guys for making this possible and for giving me feedback on how to improve the game. (Feedback is still welcomed; I’m always looking for ideas on how to improve the game)

But I think is time to move forward, but I’m not sure in which direction should I go, I’m not sure if I want to start a new fresh and completely different project or if should I be making a Sophie’s Curse sequel, but not just by myself this time, but rather form a team and make it in the unreal engine with true 3D and VR support, with better story, voice acting, better gameplay and of course a more horrifying experience; there are many things that I wanted to do differently and somehow I feel like the story needs closure and I’m still full of ideas that would make you s*** your pants xD

But I’m not sure if there are enough people interested in seeing a Sophie’s Curse sequel… please let me know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Difficulty balanced and improved. Update #260
notes.content:
Hello guys! I just wanted to let you know that in today’s update, the difficulty modes were balanced even more and improved.

After many updates, I feel like the difficulty now is perfect and completely balanced.

At the beginning I wanted all the players to have the same experience when playing the game, but soon I realized that some players wanted an easier game, while others were enjoying the hard and challenging difficulty, so I finally decided to divide the game into two difficulty modes: Curse & Nightmare.

The Curse difficulty is kind of easy/normal; it’s great for new players because it starts easy and then it keeps getting harder each checkpoint.

The Nightmare difficulty is harder, great for experienced players that like to be challenged. To be honest this is the difficulty that I prefer, I highly recommend this difficulty if you already know the mechanics of the game. (If you don’t, it could be a bit frustrating)

Also, all the known bugs had been fixed… but if you find one please let me know so I can fix it right away!

I’m really happy with the current state of the game... it may not seem like it but the game has evolved a lot since its initial release, many improvements have been made and it was all thanks to you guys!

Thank you for all the support that you’ve giving me, I’m very grateful! :)

If you have any feedback or suggestions of how can I improve the game, please let me know… it’s always great to hear what the players think.

notes.title: Dear YouTubers.
notes.content:
Just to clarify things, there is absolutely nothing stopping you from monetizing your videos using my content, you are free to do so, I don't mind... in fact I encourage you to do it ;)

Edit 2: I'm sorry guys, but I'm receiving dozens of emails from people claiming to be other YouTubers or with fake YouTube accounts, and there is no way for me to tell if an email is legit or not.

I was trying to be cool with YouTubers, but people are taking advantage... it's sad really.

This means no more free keys for now.

[strike]Also if you have a channel and want to do a let's play video feel free to ask me for a key at: TrerPlay@gmail.com or here in a comment.

When requesting a key please leave a link to your channel, so I can send you the key ;)	

Edit: You really need to have a channel to receive a free copy, I hope you understand... but I'm receiving many many emails from people claiming to be youtubers and they don't even have a channel... if you want a key you need to have at least a few let's play videos on your channel.(doesn't really matter how many subs you have)[/strike]

notes.title: Settings Added.
notes.content:
Hello guys, I just released a new update of the game that includes settings among other things like the option to lock the mouse inside the screen, in case you have more than one monitor.

The game doesn't change your resolution anymore, it uses you native resolution.(This was the most requested feature)

I also fixed a ton of bugs, plus you can not longer die randomly, it's all about a good strategy now.

I also balanced the difficulty a little bit more, please let me know what you think.

I'm listening for feedback and suggestions, we can improve the gameplay even more guys :)

I did some heavy testing on this build, but I probably missed something, If you encounter any errors, just let me know, I'll try to fix it right away!

Edit: I just fixed an error that made the game crash if you were recording... I guess Sophie was a little shy xD let me know if you are still having issues, I'll fix them right away! *Thanks to VaporTheGamer for letting me know.

Edit 2: FRAPS is no longer supported, the only way it works is if I force the resolution as in previous builds to 720p, but most players don't want that, the only solution is to play in windowed mode or use another recording software ;)
